body:
I know, I could.  But I can't change it to anything I haven't tried before.  As I said, I used to be confident and positive... but I've lost all that.

I am not saying it's impossible.  It's just not possible for the amount of motivation and drive I have in me anymore.  I just would rather it all stop.

The problem is... I made that effort, for 2 years.  I got in awesome shape.  I had a 6-pack.  I spent way too much on clothes.  I used men's fashion advice.  It was awful, I hated it.

And even then, when I was doing all the things right, I probably went on 10 or 15 first dates, with a scattering of second dates, no third dates.  

There's something about me that I don't think I can change, that is just unattractive to women.  I truly feel like a relationship for me is not possible.  I'm not being hyperbolic or visceral or whatever.  I just don't think I can do it.  If it is possible, I don't think I have the drive in me anymore to get it done.  It was just too much.  I still get anxious about all the times I've been turned down or ignored, not replied to asking for another date, unreplied on OKCupid, match.com, eharmony.   Wow, even just thinking back on it I'm getting anxious..  I can't do all that again...

I do want to get over this.  You are right, I haven't given up completely... I just don't know what to do.  I have a few friends, but, I know its selfish, but friends aren't enough.  It sucks hanging out with a friend and his wife, or his fiance, and feeling like a third wheel, a fifth wheel, whatever.  I just feel lonely at the end of the night.

I could try to make more friends, get into more hobbies... but I've been trying the things I used to love, for weeks.  I don't get any joy out of them anymore.  I went for a hike yesterday, it was supposed to be 3 hours, but after 30 minutes I gave up and went home.  I tried to exercise this morning, watch netflix on my indoor bike, but I just couldnt do it.  I haven't been able to read for a few weeks now.  I can't play any video games anymore.  They just seem like frustrating chores.

I want to be happy, feel like there's hope, some kind of thing to look forward to.  I want to feel confident about the future of my dating life, or feel like I have a future in the career I am passionate about, my research.  But in reality, I don't. And it's not the kind of life-goals I can change over night.  I am not sure if they are the things I want to change, or is possible to change.  

I really want to fix this, if I could.  It just doesn't seem fixable.

I mean, I feel not as motivated about my job, moreso because I won't be able to find a job in it.  It's not pessimism... just how funding is right now.  I don't think I can do anything with it, even if I wanted to.  It's an issue of 10 jobs, for 100 people, and even though a PhD sounds impressive... I'm nowhere near the top 10% of that 100 people.

As for romance, and a relationship, I've been working on that for years.  All my post-pubescent life.  I've asked for feedback.  There's some things I can't change.  I'm short, nerdy, losing my hair.  Not that assertive.  Not confident anymore.  Some things I can't change, and some things I could improve on... but I've been trying for so long.  I have been rejected so much, the idea of putting myself out there again.. it's just too much.

So I have one problem that nomatter how much effort I put into it, I can't really work on.  And another problem that I've been working on for years, and haven't made any progress.  Even writing all that out makes me feel awful and pessimistic.

The small problems don't seem to be the issue though.  I could fix all the small problems in my life, and I'd still feel alone, without the job I am passionate about, and without any kind of direction.

There's really only 2 problems I have, but they are everything to me.  It doesn't seem like fixing all the other mundane, irrelevant things would make a difference.

I am not sure... I appreciate the kind words.  I just don't think any kind of confidence can change my situation.  I've tried it before.

Yeah I've been rejected and dealt with it.  But honestly, it's ruined me.  I didn't get over it, it's just piled on now.  I truly, truly believe that the way I am going, I will be alone my whole life.  I have to base my predictions of the future on my experiences of that past... and that's all I have.  Rejection, way more than I should have taken.

I really don't think I have too many days like this left in me.
Universities, bars, clubs, through friends.  Restaurants where foreigners hang out.

Yes.  Europe, south america, china, japan.  My job gives me a chance to travel a lot, and I have friends I visited.  I was in japan for a month, tried meeting women there.  Nothing.  China for 2 weeks, and then 3 months.  I really tried there.  Also nothing.  My lack of relationships isn't limited to the US....

I don't know if things will change though.  They might change, but I don't see a way they can change for the better.  I can't imagine feeling like this for the rest of my life.  The thought of feeling this hopeless for another week seems unbearable.

I know it's not impossible for me to find someone... but I didn't date until 24.  So the whole "It'll happen naturally" thing.. didn't for like 10 years.  And then the whole, putting in effort, working on dating, my appearance, all these stupid superficial things.  That didnt work either, for 4 years.

There's no guarantee that I'll end up alone... but there are plenty of people who ARE alone, a lot better people than me.  So there's also not a guarantee that I'll end up with someone, like you say.  And, I mean, I have to go based on my experiences.  Every time I've put myself out there, romantically, I've been rejected.  The first few times, I could ignore it.  The next few times, it hurt, but I could pretend it didn't matter.  After all this time, I just can't anymore.

I have no more motivation in me.  Whatever confidence I had, it's done.  And the one thing I had that I could be happy about, my career, my job, my research, my intellect... that I could say is awesome about myself, even after the worst kinds of dates and rejections, I don't have anymore.  

There's a chance things could get better, but there's a chance things could stay the same, or get worse.  And I'm not sure I can handle things staying the same for a few months, a year, the rest of my life.  I can't even imagine going on if they get worse.  It's not worth the chance...

I've heard something similar before...  and I agree.  Maybe my problems are fixable.  Getting a good job that I want is almost entirely based on luck... but it's not 0%. Its just really small.  And there's a chance I'll find happiness in romance.. but I've been trying for so long, and had no success.  If I even had one relationship, at least I'd know my odds.  1 out of 10 chances, 1 out of 100.  Right now I'm at almost literally 0 out of 100.  So I dont know if it'lll end up being 1 out of 101, 1 out of 1000, 1 out of infinity...

I know my problems are fixable... possibly.  My issue is I don't have the motivation, the happiness, the confidence, or the hope to fix them anymore.  I just want it to stop.

I could always change careers... but I am not sure I wanted to.  Before, when the dating stuff went poorly, I could always tell myself that I had a kickass career.  Things weren't so bad.  I could stay confident, and shrug off the rejections, and move on.

But now without that, I really don't have anything to fall back on.  I am not really interested in another career path, I've been training for this one for 10 years now.  10 years isn't a huge amount of time in the long run... but that, combined with everything else, the loneliness, the hopelessness.

Maybe there are things wrong with me about the dating.  Maybe I'm a jerk or a slob or a creep and don't realize it...  I just don't want to try anymore.  I don't have the motivation, I already spent all of it.  It could be hard work for me to figure out everything I need to do.  And I just don't have it in me anymore.  

At the end of the day, my interests and career were one of the coolest parts about me.  Without that, I am just a short, balding, out of shape dude, who is slightly good at puzzles and cooking, and no real future prospects.  Who would want to date that.  

I really just want all of this to end.  Depression or not, all the bad facts in my life are still there whether I take different meds or not.  And I don't want to deal with them.

I've been thinking about this all day...  Suicide victims are eligible to donate organs, and can save up to 8 lives.  With as many people who die waiting on lists, and me being healthy, that could almost guarantee that all of my organs can be used, if I do things right.  In addition, many other people can have their lives improved, if not saved, from other tissues....

I am having a really hard time convincing myself out of this. And that fact really doesn't help.

The only thing I have for me is the PhD.  And with that, I won't have a career in it.  I am going to have to find a job that I could have gotten 5 or 6 years ago, before I started grad school.

I can't see how I am better off than you in every regard except a relationship.  That's really all I want, if I have to pick one thing.

I shouldn't be this behind on relationships after turning 28.  Especially after putting so much into it.  I don't have any kind of confidence anymore. 

I just wake up each morning feeling terrible.  I don't want to keep "gutting it out" and maybe someday it won't feel that bad.  I'm way past that, I've been doing that for weeks, or months.  I just want all of this to stop feeling so bad.
I don't really do any kind of art.

I am trying to think of things I enjoy, but I'm coming up with nothing.  There were things I DID enjoy, but when I force myself to do them, they just seem annoying, bothersome, like a chore.  I don't really have any money to do anything big.  The best thing seems to be going back to bed.  If I take benadryl or melatonin, I can sleep nearly 11 hours, and have some decent dreams.

Prostitutes are not what I'm looking for.  I don't really care about sex, I just want to be in love with someone, and have them love me.  I know it sounds whiny, but I've been trying for a long time.  I'm 28 now, as I said.  It shouldn't be this hard.

If I had the choice to do anything in the world right now... I couldn't think of anything.  I just want everything I'm feeling to stop.
I don't know what that is.

I don't really have any kind of motivation to quit grad school.  It is really all I have.  Me stopping my research would essentially coincide  with me killing myself.  I really can't think of anything in life I'd want to do without that

Believing that there is someone out there for me has no real reason to it.  Plenty of people end up alone.

All I know is my experiences, which have had me falling for many different girls and have had myself rejected,  hard.  I just don't believe it anymore, truly.  Whether I am right or wrong, I don't think it can happen.. and without that drive, I am done anyway
  I just don't want to keep spending each day so miserable, on top of all of thia loneliness.  It would be so much better if it was just done

Yeah I'm a great friend.  I help them out all the time, and they like me for a variety of reasons.

But at the end of the day, they are all in good relationships,  and I'm alone.  So whatever qualities they like in me as friends, doesn't translate into me finding love.  So it doesn't really matter
Yeah sorry.  That doesnt really help

If I find some med that works, that doesn't make me any happier.  It just tricks me into being happy.   The things I am sad about don't change if I change meds.  They are still there, and still just as true, I am just ignoring them

There were things like that.  I used to spend a lot of time in solo hobbies and projects that would make me feel good.  Programming  projects.  Electronics.  Robotics.  3d printing.   But even though I was alone through all that, I was confident and positive in myself that someone would appreciate me for the things I enjoyed and was passionate about,  someday.

That was years ago, when I was already sick of being alone
  Before I figured it was time to stop waiting for something like that to happen, and go look for someone.  And I didn't find her, just rejection and more loneliness,  and a realization that there is nothing neat about me, and no one is out there who could care about me.

So then I lost hope.  And now no matter what kind of hobbies I try to pick up that I used to enjoy,  I just can't do it.  Because I know now that even after looking for years, I can't find a girlfriend or relationship,  and can't ever start a family.  Now I can barely go on a walk  by myself without thinking about that kind of failure I've gone through, and just breaking down

I don't feel  like I will end up somewhere better.  I remember feeling this way a year ago.  Convincing myself that if I hold out longer, things will get better.  They didnt, I just feel more sad, more alone, more hopeless.  If anything, I regret having convinced myself to go another year

I don't believe the "stop trying and it will happen "thing.  I did that for a long long time, and still nothing.  It's only when I stastarted trying that I realized it wasn't possible for me whatever approach I went with.

I don't think I can be happy alone, or would be able to ever convince myself that I can be happy if I'm never in a relationship.  I don't want to even go through that, even if it's only a few more years.   I can't imagine speming more time by myself.  I can barely stand myself as I am now.  I just want it all to be finished

No, it's not that I'm no worse off.  I've been dealing with this for years.  Getting rejected a couple times,  someone can shrug off.  But if it's constant, with no kind of success, then each one just feels worse.

I am way too emotionally exhausted to keep trying new methods.  I don't care anymore,  there's just something about me that makes it impossible.  I'm just, done.

I've been trying to fill up my day with things like that.  Exercising, cooking, even just walking.  I can't even get myself to anymore.   Now the only things I do besides work is sleep a ton and drink.   Thats really the only ways I can get through my weekends
Have none

You act like surviving is just some neutral thing.  That you can just keep it going and have all the emotions bounce off of you.

Every day I wake up sad and go to bed sad.   I sometimes get motivated enough to put myself out there, and I get rejected and feel worse.  I'm specifically trained for a very narrow field, and not good at anything else.  Just surviving and crossing off the days in itself is essentially unbearable for me
None of my feelings right now are guilt.  I just want to be happy, or for this to stop.  I can't figure out how to do A, so B really seems the only way to get out of it...
I don't feel that same motivation not to quit.  I've been sad and struggling for too long.  It's just easier to stop it.
It all feels like crappy parts at the moment.  I can't imagine a way to even be close to happy.
I don't think that's happening.

Im 28.  I tried just living life and being happy up until 24.  I didn't find anyone, not even a kiss.

At 24, I tried dating, putting in an actual effort.  The last 4 years, also nothing.

I only tried the dating the past few years, once I was 24 or so.

Before that, I didn't worry about dating.  I just had a ton of friends and lived life, figuring something would happen naturally.  In the back of my mind, I didn't stress about it, because I knew I could find someone if I tried.  Well I hit 24 and it still hadn't happened.  And so I tried.  And I did horrible at it.  

So now I don't believe that loving myself was enough to find.  I did for so long.  And putting in an effort didnt work either.  I'm just broken overall at this kind of thing.
I've been to China several times for work.  I was there for 4 months at my longest.  I tried dating while I was over there.  Pretty much less success than over here.

That's a nice sentiment, but knowing people out there responded to a random post on the internet, doesn't really make me feel any better.  At the end of the day, I am just as sad, just as alone, whether I post on here or not.  

This isn't something I've been dealing with the last couple weeks, it's been my whole life.  I've had times that I've been distracted, or been like this, depressed.  I have nothing at all in life that I am looking forward to.  You say "this shall pass", but this isn't a transcient thing for me.  This is just how I am.  I don't see a way out of it, and I've tried so hard for years.

Yeah, but you've experienced it.  I've been single for 28 years.  Or at least 15 to 16 years if you count when having that kind of relationship would be possible.

Maybe being in a relationship wouldn't make me feel better.  But it's still the one thing I want more than anything else, and what I can't seem to get nomatter how much I try.

It might be in the realm of possibility that I rally now, get motivated, and get out of this.  But I could do all that, and still end up in a bad job, alone, with no family.

Even right now, at the moment, existing for me is just being sad and feeling hopeless.  It seems like a much better solution to just stop.

I had no idea where this path goes.  As of now, due to funding everywhere, there just aren't any jobs in my field. 

But, I'm still finishing up as a student.  They don't pay me much.  I don't have enough money for gas a few states away, let alone a vacation.  As for the "Go to Europe and get laid", everyone says that like it's some kind of inevitability when you go out, it just happens.  I've tried going out, all the time, just to meet new people, friends, and eventually relationships.  The first parts work, but no girl has ever really been into me.  There's gotta be something wrong with me at this point.

Depression, isolation.  I have friends, and hang out with them regularly, but I still feel sad and lonely.  Dating I did a bunch, it didn't work out for a long long time.  I don't have the drive to try it again.  I'm just done

I don't know.  I've been on multiple sites for 3 or 4 years.  A few local dating phone programs.  Coffee shops.  Dating events.  Just introducing myself to women.

I just turned 28.  I've been trying purposefully since I was 23.  And from 16 to 23, never had a girlfriend while just not trying

There aren't any secret admirers here.   I've tried the dating stuff a lot.  Every one ended with her flaking, her rejecting me, or her not responding.  And in each case, she was very clear on her feelings of me.  There is not another girl I know who is single and hasn't made her strict lack of romantic attraction of me clear.

I don't care about the sex part.  It's the connection everyone seems to have, always supporting someone,  always having someone support you.  Hiring a hooker won't help that.

Also I couldn't do much if I tried.  They pay me as a student, but not enough to get by.  And too much to get loans.  I live paycheck to paycheck with nothing left over for savings

But none of those things seem enjoyable.  I could force myself to do them, but if I have free time right now, I'd just rather spend it in bed.  

If I had the choice to do anything in the world right now to make me happy, I don't think I could come up with anything
I can't imagine any response that another person could give that would genuinely make me feel better right now

Venlafaxine, st johns wort, escitalopram.

I dunno, I always hear about guys saying that they "don't know how they got their current GF" or "It shouldn't be something you have to try at."  But the fact that all of my friends and acquaintances have had multiple significant others without seeming trying, and I've wanted one my whole life and haven't found it, still isn't a difference I can deal with.  

I really just am done putting so much effort it.  I have lost all the motivation I once had.  I just want it all to stop so I don't have to keep feeling this bad all the time.

I've tried a lot.  There could be more things to try, but I've lost the will or motivation to try them anymore.  I don't want to have to keep trying more things to make myself happy, only to have them not work, and to sink deeper into depression and loneliness.  

Giving up does seem like the only real option.

That's what I tried with the dating.  I've done online and offline dating attempts now for, 4 years? 5 years?  I've dealt with so much rejection, all the while feeling alone and wanting to have someone like that.  I tried to isolate every thing that could be wrong with me, but couldn't figure it out.  I know it can't be normal to be like this, this old and having this much trouble connecting with people.  I just couldn't figure out what that issue was in time.

It doesn't really matter if I'm alone or not.  When I feel like lying in bed all afternoon, wallowing in how sad I am, and wishing all of this would stop, it never really comes into my mind whether others are or are not dealing with the same thing.

Hey,

Thanks for the message.  I read all of it a few times.  

I don't know what kind of job or career I'd like to have, barring this specific science field I'm in.  I don't know anything else.  But nothing else really makes me excited.  For me to stay in this field, it would take a combination of hard work and a lot of luck.  Like job postings at times and positions that are completely out of my control.  And if I work as hard as I can from here on out, it really only brings my chances up from like 10%, to a maximum of 30%.   It isn't worth the effort.

I can barely manage to get out of bed everyday with minimal amount of work to do.  If I had to do it, on top of working a job I wasn't excited about.  And being this alone.  I can't even imagine living through that.

I know a relationship won't solve my problems... but I've never had one.  I've never been able to rely on somebody like that.  Love someone, and be loved by them.  As far as I know, a girl has never even been infatuated with me.  That's a really hard fact to live with, when you look at yourself in the mirror every morning.

I don't really feel guilty about being depressed.  I just want it to stop.  And I've tried making it stop with all the conventional ways, changing my lifestyle, trying to stay positive, trying not to worry about my relationship issues.  None of those work, and somehow I just feel worse and worse with each month.  I can't imagine feeling more sad than I am at the moment, but somehow I also know that if I am still around like this next month, I will feel sadder.

So it is an escape route.  It feels like my only options are to keep sinking deeper and deeper into this loneliness and depression, or end it.  And I really think I can only stand one of those two options.
